# EcclesiaOS v1.0.42

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.42 is a stability patch for the v1.0.41 release. It corrects release formatting checks and confirms the complete application suite, dependency audits, and production asset build.

## Fixes and verification

- Fixed all Pint formatting violations in the website controller, routes, and member registration tests.
- Confirmed member-only navigation hides restricted Programs & Attendance entries.
- Confirmed returning members can create portal accounts and link them to existing or newly created member records.
- Confirmed Website Studio column backgrounds, media controls, widget icons, and public rendering remain functional.
- Composer audit completed with no security advisories.
- npm audit completed with zero vulnerabilities.
- Production Vite assets built successfully.
- Full test suite passed: 272 tests and 3,112 assertions.
